paragraphs.text: Sardia was a nation of dwarves during the time of the Brothers' War of Terisiare on Dominaria .

Sardia was a mountain nation of dwarves inhabiting the Sardian Mountains during the Brothers' War . The mountains were rich in metal and stone, so Urza traded with the dwarves to fuel his war effort. Urza used the dwarves' resources to create the Colossus of Sardia , which was used in the final battle of the war on Argoth . The dwarves, along with some goblin tribes, also invented a substance like gunpowder, an otherwise rarely seen invention on Dominaria. The Brothers soon made much use of this "goblin powder" in their wartime technologies. After years of service, Urza found out that the dwarves of Sardia were trading with Mishra too; they eventually rose against Argive , and for this, they were slaughtered. When Urza betrayed the Sardian dwarves, they called upon the might of their neighbors, the Sardian minotaurs , for aid. During the last years of the war, surviving Sardian dwarves reported that burning rains were falling from the sky into their land, searing the flesh and corroding any exposed mechanism. It is unknown if the dwarves survived past the Ice Age .
